lines.japanese: そりゃ言われなくとも庇うっての！
lines.english: Like I needed to be told to protect her!

lines.japanese: 俺は両脚の瞬発力を爆発させてコンクリートを蹴った。
lines.english: I drove off the concrete with every ounce of power in my legs.

lines.japanese: 飛びつくや否や、日和子さんの肩と頭をしゃにむに鷲づかみ、力まかせに胸の中へ引きよせる。
lines.english: The instant I reached her, I seized Hiyoko by the head and shoulders and wrenched her against my chest with all my strength.

lines.japanese: 瞬間、痛みだか衝撃だか何だかが耳とこめかみを打ちつけ、視界に白光が弾けた。殴られてもいない首の後ろに、ずきりと鋭い痛みが走る。内側から忍びよる重い感覚。どこかで誰かが俺を嗤っていた。
lines.english: In that instant, something—pain, impact, I could no longer tell—slammed into my ear and temple, and white light burst across my vision. A sharp pain lanced through the back of my neck, though nothing had struck it. A leaden sensation crept toward me from within. Somewhere, someone was laughing at me.

lines.japanese: これは──違う、聴覚に直接飛びこんでくる叫び声。これは、ああ、なんだ、日和子さんだ。
lines.english: No—this was different. A cry pouring straight into my ears. This was... Oh. Of course. Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: 「ひよこさん……いいから、にげて……」
俺の、意識は、薄れてゆく。
「て、店長大変です！　千歳さんが！」
ああ、良かった、マスターが来てくれたならもう大丈夫だ……なにしろ彼はああ見えて空手の有段者……内緒だけど、若いころは一端のケンカ番長だとか……。
lines.english: Ah, good. The boss was here. Everything would be all right now... Despite appearances, he had a black belt in karate... and though it was a secret, rumor said he'd been a notorious brawler in his youth...

lines.japanese: い、いやあ、餅は餅屋ってね……慣れないことはするもんじゃありません。
lines.english: W-well, you know what they say—leave it to the pros... You really shouldn't try doing things you're not used to.

lines.japanese: そして俺の意識は、あるべきところからずるりと引きずりおとされました。
lines.english: And then my consciousness slipped from its proper place and was dragged down.
